Early Bird ★ JPY 3980 All-You-Can-Drink with Draft Beer & Smoked Sushi, Hand-Rolled Tempura, 17 Dishes 'Early Bird Year-End Party Course'17 items

Introducing an unbeatable early bird plan perfect for year-end parties starting early, zero parties, or quick gatherings! Enjoy our signature "Smoked Sushi," along with four pieces of expertly crafted "Edo-style Sushi," crispy "Special Hand-Rolled Tempura," and delightful winter favorites like "Fried Oysters" and "Three Types of Sashimi," totaling 17 popular dishes. Plus, this package includes a 90-minute all-you-can-drink option featuring draft beer! This special price is available for a limited time, so be sure to make your reservation soon. *This offer is exclusive to customers who enter between 17:00 and 17:45, with a seating time limit of 90 minutes.

This light plan features our signature "aromatic smoked sushi" along with a selection of 14 dishes, including savory hand-rolled sushi and simmered cheek meat, all at a great price. Enjoy a complimentary drink of your choice, making it ideal for a post-work drink or an impromptu gathering on the same day. Come and casually experience our culinary delights!

Reservation No.1: Tamatebako Sashimi and Smoked Sushi, Tempura of Thick Rolls 'Evolving Sushi Course'15 items

Experience the excitement of our signature "Tamatebako" presentation! A feast for both the eyes and palate, this flagship course features 15 exquisite dishes, starting with the "Tamatebako Sashimi" that releases a gentle waft of smoke upon opening the lid. Enjoy innovative sushi creations and crispy thick roll tempura, all part of our unique lineup that adds a playful twist to traditional Japanese cuisine at "Saigyo no Bansan." If you're unsure about your choice for a date, girls' night out, or dinner with friends, this is definitely the one!

[Oyster 5 Types Tasting] Specialty - Fried Oyster Roll, Sushi, and Oyster Noodle 'Ultimate Oyster Course'18 items

Fresh, Smoked, Fried, Rolled, and Finished — A luxurious creative kaiseki experience that fully indulges your senses in the umami of oysters. Starting with a selection of five types of carefully chosen large fresh oysters, followed by oysters marinated in kombu kelp served in a treasure box, and culminating in our specialty, the "Deep-fried Kara-age Roll infused with rich oyster broth," this course is truly an oyster lover's paradise. It concludes with sushi crafted by our skilled chefs and a comforting bowl of "Hot Oyster Noodle Soup" that captures every last drop of flavor, making it an exquisite choice for oyster enthusiasts.

The pinnacle of luxury! A special plan to indulge in premium ingredients and exquisite sushi to your heart's content. In addition to lavish dishes like "Abalone" and "Eel," enjoy an incredible selection of top-notch sushi, including our signature "Smoked Sushi," all available as an "All you can eat" option! This special course, where skilled chefs meticulously prepare each piece of authentic sushi, truly lives up to the name of "Musou." Perfect for special occasions such as anniversaries, business meetings, or celebrations. As part of our anniversary celebration, you can also add an all-you-can-drink option for just JPY 1,000.

A special course perfect for year-end parties with important colleagues and friends, featuring a relaxing two-hour all-you-can-drink option! Enjoy our signature "Smoked Sushi," expertly crafted "Edo-style Sushi (4 pieces)," crispy "Special Hand-Rolled Tempura," delightful "Fried Oysters" for winter, and a selection of "Three Types of Sashimi," among a luxurious total of 17 dishes. Our all-you-can-drink menu includes draft beer, highballs, shochu, umeshu, and more! This is the number one banquet plan for organizers, ensuring satisfaction.
